name: SimpleQA
intro: SimpleQA是一个由OpenAI开发的事实性问答基准，旨在评估大型语言模型回答简短、事实明确问题的能力。该基准通过对抗性方式收集，针对GPT-4的回答进行设计，确保问题具有单一且无争议的答案，从而简化评分。SimpleQA旨在测试模型是否能识别其知识边界，避免对不确定的问题做出猜测性回答。
build_method: 人工出题, 四模型对抗筛选, 独立双人答案验证
metric: 总体正确率, 尝试题正确率, F-score
task_type: 开放式问答, 事实验证
build_method_en: Human question writing, four-model adversarial filtering, independent two-trainer verification
intro_en: SimpleQA is a factual question-answering benchmark developed by OpenAI to evaluate large language models' ability to answer short, fact-based questions. Collected adversarially and designed against GPT-4's responses, it ensures questions have a single, unambiguous answer to simplify scoring. SimpleQA aims to test whether models can recognize their knowledge boundaries and avoid guessing on uncertain questions.
metric_en: Overall correct, Correct given attempted, F-score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.04368 Sections 2-4. AI trainers write short, specific, evergreen fact questions with a reference answer and evidence. A question survives only if at least one of four reviewed OpenAI model responses is wrong; ChatGPT classifiers flag criteria violations and make light copy edits. A blind second trainer independently answers and checks the criteria, then an answer-matching classifier and a two-unique-domain evidence rule gate retention. A third trainer audits 1,000 examples, yielding an estimated 3 percent dataset error rate. The final 4,326 questions are graded as correct, incorrect, or not attempted and summarized by overall correct, correct given attempted, and their harmonic-mean F-score.
